tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. The logo was drawn on white, so light is the primary theme.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table headers and form fields sitting on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on surface and surface-raised. Light value is the logo's pure black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions, metadata on surface and surface-raised (5.7:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: q2m-blue
tokens.usage: The logo's dot-grid blue. Use for the dot motif, large display accents (24px and up), icons and fills. On white it is 4.44:1, so do not set body-size text in it; use action instead.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links and small blue text. 5.9:1 on surface in light, 6.4:1 in dark.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an action fill.

tokens.name: q2m-grey
tokens.usage: The SOLUTIONS grey from the logo. Decorative blocks and large display words only; 3.5:1 on white, so never body text.

tokens.name: block-dark
tokens.usage: Solid dark slabs on banners, booth panels and section bands. Put ink-inverse text and q2m-blue dots on it.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on block-dark.

tokens.name: tint-blue
tokens.usage: Quiet blue relief behind callouts, tags and highlighted rows. ink reads on it in both themes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Booth backdrop and website hero headline only.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: We build AI agents that do real work inside your systems.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: From proof of concept to production in weeks.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and tags. Always set in capitals in the copy itself.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Stand numbers, dates, metrics and code.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Dot-grid pitch on small marks; button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Dot-grid pitch on banners; card padding; phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding on large panels.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space between sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Space between sections on desktop and slide margins.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels and image frames.

tokens.name: radius-pill
